desc: Design CRT prime-power construction and verify local order lemmas via LTE (odd p: ord_{p^{e+1}}(1+p)=p^e since v_p((1+p)^{p^k}-1)=k+1; p=2,e=1: ord_4(3)=2; p=2,e≥2: ord_{2^{e+2}}(3)=2^e since v_2(3^{2^k}-1)=k+2) and confirm bound M≤N²≤1e18 with gcd(A,M)=1.

Implement the complete Python solution: fast factorization (trial division by sieve primes with early exit, plus Miller-Rabin primality test and Pollard-Rho fallback for the worst case T=1e4 with large prime/semiprime N), local constructors (p,e)→(a,m) [odd p: a=1+p, m=p^(e+1); p=2,e=1: a=3,m=4; p=2,e≥2: a=3,m=2^(e+2)], iterative CRT over coprime moduli via modular inverse, N=1 edge case outputting (1,1), and fast stdin/stdout for T≤1e4.

Brute-force verify the constructed multiplicative order equals N for small and edge cases (N=1, 2, powers of 2, odd prime powers, highly composite N) and assert 1≤A,M≤1e18 and gcd(A,M)=1 — verified exhaustively for N∈[1,2000] by true brute force, plus edge cases (2^k up to 2^29, prime powers, 10^9±1, semiprimes >1000², highly composite) and 300 random N∈[1,10^9] via the rigorous pow criterion (ord|N and ord∤N/q for all q|N ⟹ ord=N); all bounds and gcd checks passed.
